_comment: Single source of truth for the invitation. Edit this file, then run: python3 build.py   Any value starting with TODO is still missing.

wedding._comment: date = YYYY-MM-DD, time = HH:MM (24h). Timezone is used for the countdown.

ceremony._comment: venue_phrase is the full Greek phrase used in sentences (e.g. 'στον Ιερό Ναό Αγίου Δημητρίου Θεσσαλονίκης'). Leave maps_url empty to auto-generate a Google Maps search from venue + place.
ceremony.venue_phrase: TODO: στον Ιερό Ναό … (περιοχή σε γενική)

google._comment: sheet_id: the long id in the Google Sheet URL. apps_script_url: the /exec URL of the deployed Apps Script web app.

cloudinary._comment: Guest photo uploads. Needs an unsigned upload preset in the couple's own Cloudinary account.
